diagram_previews.alt: The Y-piece: four unit squares in a row with a fifth square attached below the second square.

A 15 by 15 grid tiled by 45 Y-shaped pieces (four squares in a line plus one square beside the second square), outlined with thick lines and coloured in four colours so that neighbouring pieces differ.

difficulty_rationale: The claim has to be disproved by an explicit tiling. No tiling is built from simple blocks (5 x 10 rectangles and the like), so a tiling must be found by a long, careful search with interlocking pieces.
